p5_wording: Cohort ceiling: a candidate is visible only if the player has a row in player_play.csv, and that file carries rows for the draft-prospect cohort in players.csv alone, so an opposing route-runner outside the cohort is invisible. 130 of 326 turns (39.9%) have no opposing player row at all, and 116 (35.6%) have opposing players recorded but no route-runner among them; on those turns the candidate count is limited by the cohort, not by the play. Every candidate count here is therefore a lower bound on what the full frame-level data would show, and the ceiling below is exact only for this file.
